audit_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2H-B - Market-Data Provider Rights & Contractual Due Diligence Matrix
audit_metadata.auditor_role: Market-Data Licensing Specialist & Quantitative Systems Auditor

tiingo.non_professional_eligibility: Permitted for individual natural persons acting solely for personal non-commercial investment research.
tiingo.binding_contract_language_summary: Grants a limited, personal, revocable, non-exclusive license to access data. Explicit clause: 'You may not redistribute the data in any form.'
tiingo.automated_research_permission: PERMITTED via documented REST and WebSocket APIs within tier rate limits.
tiingo.local_storage_and_caching: PERMITTED for individual internal strategy modeling and offline backtesting. Commercial database mirror prohibited.
tiingo.derived_data_retention: PERMITTED for internal risk metrics, portfolio weights, and signals provided raw quotes are not reverse-engineered.
tiingo.redistribution_ban: STRICTLY PROHIBITED without commercial redistribution addendum.
tiingo.corporate_actions_coverage: Comprehensive split-adjusted and dividend-adjusted end-of-day series available.
tiingo.india_residency_restrictions: NONE documented for pure data subscription. Accessible globally via standard payment methods.

unverified_contractual_clauses.post_termination_raw_data_retention: UNKNOWN (standard terms require deletion of proprietary feeds upon termination).

tiingo.overall_suitability_assessment: HIGH for prospective E0/D2 daily bar input, pending owner plan selection.

polygon_io.non_professional_eligibility: Individual plan users must certify non-professional status under CTA/UTP definitions.
polygon_io.binding_contract_language_summary: Permitted use is restricted to personal, non-commercial development and personal trading. Redistribution triggers commercial licensing.
polygon_io.automated_research_permission: PERMITTED via official REST and streaming endpoints.
polygon_io.local_storage_and_caching: PERMITTED for internal algorithmic evaluation. Construction of independent historical data redistribution products prohibited.
polygon_io.redistribution_ban: STRICTLY PROHIBITED to any third party or public dashboard.
polygon_io.corporate_actions_coverage: Reference ticker events API provides stock splits and cash dividends.

unverified_contractual_clauses.historical_tick_data_caching_limits: UNKNOWN (flat file vs API query storage rights differentiation).

polygon_io.overall_suitability_assessment: HIGH for EOD and minute bars; requires developer subscription.

alpaca.legal_entity: AlpacaDB, Inc. (Data/Tech API) & Alpaca Securities LLC (Broker-Dealer, FINRA/SIPC)
alpaca.non_professional_eligibility: Retail algorithmic traders qualify as non-professional; requires NASDAQ/NYSE subscriber agreement acceptance.
alpaca.binding_contract_language_summary: Market data license is non-exclusive, non-transferable, and strictly for personal use in algorithmic trading decisions.
alpaca.local_storage_and_caching: PERMITTED for personal execution engine decision-making; redistribution or warehousing prohibited.
alpaca.derived_data_retention: PERMITTED for personal trading execution signals.
alpaca.redistribution_ban: STRICTLY PROHIBITED under Broker API / Market Data Display agreements.
alpaca.corporate_actions_coverage: Adjusted bars available; standalone deep corporate action history is limited in basic tier.
alpaca.india_residency_restrictions: CRITICAL REGULATORY CONSTRAINT: While data API is technically accessible, opening a funded live trading account from India with Alpaca Securities LLC is subject to RBI LRS compliance and partner arrangements. RBI LRS prohibits margin trading and foreign derivative trading abroad.

unverified_contractual_clauses.pure_paper_simulated_account_eligibility: PERMITTED (no real funds or cross-border remittance involved).

alpaca.overall_suitability_assessment: SUITABLE for paper evaluation; live execution from India requires strict LRS compliance.

interactive_brokers.legal_entity: Interactive Brokers LLC (US Broker-Dealer) / Interactive Brokers India Pvt. Ltd.
interactive_brokers.subscription_tier_examined: Client Portal / TWS API Non-Professional Bundles
interactive_brokers.non_professional_eligibility: Must complete Form 4001 non-professional questionnaire; requires active funded account.
interactive_brokers.binding_contract_language_summary: Customer may use market data solely for Customer own internal investment purposes. Redistribution or sharing across accounts is prohibited.
interactive_brokers.automated_research_permission: PERMITTED via TWS API, IB Gateway, or Client Portal API.
interactive_brokers.local_storage_and_caching: RESTRICTED: Real-time tick caching strictly regulated by exchanges. Historical EOD bars for personal modeling permitted.
interactive_brokers.redistribution_ban: STRICTLY ENFORCED under exchange audit penalties.
interactive_brokers.corporate_actions_coverage: EXCELLENT: Full corporate action, dividend, and split handling built into TWS data model.
interactive_brokers.india_residency_restrictions: CRITICAL REGULATORY CONSTRAINT: Indian residents trading US markets via IBKR LLC must route funds through RBI LRS (max $250,000 USD/fiscal year). Strict FEMA prohibition on day-trading on margin, short selling, and leveraged derivatives overseas.

unverified_contractual_clauses.exchange_fee_waiver_thresholds_for_paper: UNKNOWN (typically requires minimum equity or commissions in live parent account).

interactive_brokers.overall_suitability_assessment: HIGH for institutional execution fidelity; complex onboarding and Indian regulatory constraints apply.

governance_mandate.owner_action_required: Owner must review terms, select one provider (DEC-01), and execute appropriate subscriber agreement (DEC-02).
